incident-bot: P1 - HighlandBank VPC: automated retention job failed while exporting debug logs. Possible PII exposure in raw blob. Pager: @Taylor (oncall-sre). Link: https://alerts.redwood.local/1932104567 :rotating_light:
Taylor (oncall-sre): Got it — I'm on the page. First pass: what's the tenant id and which storage backend?
Liam (cs-highlandbank): hi team — HighlandBank tenant ID hb-8672. Customer ticket: #HB-429. They reported an unexpected data export request from our side yesterday. Very sensitive — legal already flagged this as potential e-discovery.
Alice (infra): The export job targeted their dedicated-pool log bucket in us-east-2: s3://redwood-dedicated-hb-8672/logs/raw/2026-03-15/. The retention job errored with access/permission timeout; looks like multipart copy failed.
Maya (security): :warning: We need to assume PII present until proven otherwise. Do NOT share raw files outside internal secure stores. Quarantine current artifacts, snapshot them immutable, and start redact-first workflow. Also we need to know who requested any retention override.
Taylor (oncall-sre): Action plan proposal: 1) isolate bucket (Alice) 2) snapshot/immutable copy to secure archive (Alice + Chen) 3) run automated redaction pipeline on a copy (Chen) 4) legal to confirm retention exception / e-discovery needs (Priya) 5) coordinate customer comms (Liam + Nora). Any objections?
Nora (product-ops): No objections. We should avoid a cold rollback that deletes evidence — preserve for legal hold.
Chen (runtime): Starting a read-only snapshot now. Running checksum on objects to verify integrity before redaction. Sample command I'm running:
```
aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-dedicated-hb-8672 --prefix logs/raw/2026-03-15/ 
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-dedicated-hb-8672/logs/raw/2026-03-15/ s3://redwood-secure-snapshots/hb-8672/2026-03-15/ --recursive --storage-class STANDARD_IA
```
I'll spin a worker to run the redact job with the safe-regex set.
Alice (infra): I applied a deny ACL for external service principals and rotated the bucket policy to block public exports. Also created a snapshot object lock (governance mode) so nothing can be deleted while legal reviews.
Maya (security): Good. We need an auditable trail of every action and the KMS CMK used for the snapshot. Chen, include `--sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/redwood-secure` in the copy command.
Chen (runtime): Copy finished to secure snapshot. I ran a quick grep sample and found one entry with an unredacted SSN-like pattern. Masked example (I removed actual numbers):
```
[REDACTED] user_lookup: {"user_id": "uid_1234", "ssn": "***-**-****", "email": "j.smith@highlandbank.com"}
```
I will run the redact pipeline next (regex-based + name-entity scrub). This will produce two artifacts: `hb-8672-redacted-logs.tar.gz` and `hb-8672-raw-checksums.txt` (hashes only).
Priya (legal): For any retention exception / e-discovery: legal requires requestor, purpose, retention window, custodian list, and explicit account manager sign-off. We cannot release raw PII to customer. If HighlandBank requests raw logs for legal, we need a signed subpoena or internal legal approval. For now, preserve snapshot under legal hold.
Liam (cs-highlandbank): Understood. HighlandBank legal is preparing documentation but asked if we can provide redacted logs for immediate triage. They need timestamps and error-level lines only.
Taylor (oncall-sre): We can provide redacted artifact. Proposed short-term mitigation: generate redacted archive, store in secure share (expiring link), and provide a summary to the customer. If legal obtains formal request, we can follow legal handoff process for unredacted material.
Nora (product-ops): Please include token-level cost breakdown and whether retention job failed due to size/batch config; customer will ask for root cause not just logs.
Alice (infra): Redaction job ran. Produced `hb-8672-redacted-logs.tar.gz` (encrypted with KMS) and `hb-8672-raw-checksums.txt` in the legal hold bucket. Commands used:
```
# run redact container
docker run --rm redwood/redact:stable \
  --input s3://redwood-secure-snapshots/hb-8672/2026-03-15/ \
  --output s3://redwood-secure-artifacts/hb-8672/2026-03-15/ \
  --rules s3://redwood-configs/redact-rules/default.json \
  --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:111122223333:key/redwood-secure
```
Chen (runtime): Verifying redaction quality on a random sample: no SSN patterns, emails partially masked, IPs hashed. Generating summary stats (line counts, redaction count) and uploading to incident doc.
Priya (legal): Approved redacted artifact delivery to customer for triage. Legal hold remains on snapshot. Timeline: we need to retain the raw snapshot 7 years (e-discovery potential) or until formal release/closing. That retention window will be documented and escalated to compliance.
Liam (cs-highlandbank): Thank you — I'll relay to HighlandBank that we can deliver the redacted set now and legal is holding the raw snapshot. They'll follow up with their legal team about formal requests.
Taylor (oncall-sre): Postmortem action items: 1) fix multipart copy timeout that caused failure (Alice) 2) add automated detection for PII patterns during export (Chen + Maya) 3) make redaction-runbook first-class for VPC/dedicated exports (Nora) 4) document legal-hold workflow and owner (Priya). Assigning owners now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place, customer redacted artifact delivered, legal hold established. Incident moved to "Mitigated". Paging cleared for @Taylor.
Priya (legal): I'll draft the retention exception memo and send to compliance. Please add chain-of-custody notes to the incident doc (who touched what artifact and when).
Taylor (oncall-sre): Adding chain-of-custody entries now. Closing loop: any outstanding asks from CS or product before I close the thread?
Liam (cs-highlandbank): All good from customer side for now. We'll reopen if HighlandBank requests raw materials with legal paperwork. Thanks team. :heart:
Nora (product-ops): I'll follow up on the product action items and coordinate timeline for safer export defaults.
Chen (runtime): Uploading final checksums and redact metrics to incident doc.
Taylor (oncall-sre): Thanks everyone — marking incident as resolved in the tracker, will kick off RCA doc tomorrow.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1932104567 status changed to RESOLVED by Taylor (oncall-sre) at 1932105142
